get.description: Read-only current output review. Pending and unknown measurements do not imply approval. No work is created on read.

post.description: Explicitly reconcile the one canonical review. A consumed allowance never dispatches again. No extra user credit; creator approval remains separate.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable transport UUID. Changing it never resets the output review allowance.

post.description: Commit the original output cancellation fence before child reconciliation. Preserve the generated image and measured usage; no refund or generation restart.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable transport UUID for this cancellation.

SkillMemoryResolution.description: What resolving one (graphId, nodeId) pair produced. status is resolved when the memorized node was found; graph_not_found covers BOTH a graph that does not exist and one this workspace does not own (deliberately indistinguishable); node_not_found means the graph is there but the node is gone; not_a_graph_reference is a citation that names no graph (a v3 publisher_policy evidence entry); not_resolved_truncated means the Skill cites more memories than one call resolves. An infrastructure failure is NOT in this list - the request fails instead, so an outage is never reported as a vanished memory.

memoryId.description: graphId:nodeId - the same handle POST /memory/start accepts, so a cited memory can be replayed without reassembling it.

node.description: The memorized graph node itself. Same projection as GET /graphs/{graphId}/snapshot, plus hasImage.

hasImage.description: Whether GET /graphs/{graphId}/nodes/{nodeId}/image would serve bytes. An image over that endpoint size cap is still true here and answers 413 there.

trajectory.description: Curation for this memory, when it has been summarized.

allOf.description: One evidence[] entry. A v3 publisher_policy entry names no graph, which is why the graph fields are nullable.
The canvas trajectory a LEARNED Skill was bound to. Null on a built (ag.memory-skill.v4) Skill, which records provenance in references instead.

SkillMemoryReference.description: One references[] entry of a BUILT Skill: a graph plus the nodes in it the Skill Builder drew the method from. For ag.memory-skill.v4 this is the only provenance shape guaranteed to be present - workflowRef is null and evidence may be empty, while the contract requires at least one reference.

sourceMemoryId.description: The memoryId the reference itself cited, present when kind is memory_path. Distinct from each resolved node own memoryId.

counts.description: Over EVERY graph-shaped citation listed: workflowRef, evidence entries and reference nodes alike.

truncated.description: True when the Skill cites more distinct memories than this operation resolves in one call. Those refs are still listed, with status not_resolved_truncated.

draft.description: The ag.memory-skill.v4 draft, present once status is ready. Nothing is published until it is accepted.

current.description: What you have on screen for that section, so a rewrite builds on your edit rather than reverting to what the agent first wrote.

expectedDraftSha256.description: The draftSha256 you reviewed. A mismatch returns 409 DRAFT_CHANGED rather than publishing bytes you were never shown.

edits.description: Optional per-section replacements: title, goal, instructions, acceptanceCriteria, failureModes, steps, applicability. References and evidence are provenance and cannot be edited.

estimatedMinutes.description: Wall clock this source will be given, in whole minutes. Grows with the number of canvases or memory paths, because a build costs one model turn per round and rounds grow with the source. A budget, not a prediction: most builds finish well inside it.

skill.description: The partial v4 body as the model writes it. Everything submit_skill_draft stamps (identity, goal, instructions, each reference's graph facts, build) is filled in here from buildId (or a placeholder without one), never read from this field.

buildId.description: When present, resolves that build and checks every reference against its real graphs (referencesChecked: true). Without it, only schema and structure are checked.

oneOf.description: The schema-only result (no buildId in the request): contentSha256 is deliberately absent. Identity and provenance come from a build, so this path cannot produce a hash build-accept would recognize.
The build-scoped result (buildId given and every reference checked against its real graphs): contentSha256 is the real hash for that build.

errors.description: One entry per issue, as "path: message".

stampedFields.description: Fields the model never writes -- submit_skill_draft fills every one.

documents.description: v6: paths of the skill documents this step relies on.

path.description: Relative path inside the skill, e.g. references/planning.md.

reviewBeforeRun.description: Must be true for a script: show it to the user and get approval before running it.

targetSkillId.description: One new workspace identity; never reuse the official source ID.

skillId.description: Optional for a new pipeline (pass one to make retries safe); required with expectedRevision to write the next revision.

expectedRevision.description: Null for a new pipeline; otherwise the current revision being replaced.

instructions.description: How an agent runs the whole pipeline: order, gates, routing, budgets and stop conditions.

documents.description: v6: paths of the skill documents this step relies on.

path.description: Relative path inside the skill, e.g. references/planning.md.

reviewBeforeRun.description: Must be true for a script: show it to the user and get approval before running it.

documents.description: Files the pipeline carries (reference docs, JSON templates, helper scripts, agent config), stored byte for byte. At most 40000 characters each and 250000 in total. Defaults to none.
